checks.command: l4 run mv-cases.l4 ; l4 run mv-third-parties-cases.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: ss 2 to 16. mv-act.l4 has the compulsory-insurance offence (s 3), what makes a policy comply (s 4) and the insurer's duty to satisfy a judgment (s 9). mv-third-parties.l4 has the five ways the cover is protected from being defeated: agreements with a passenger (s 5), conditions in the policy (s 7), restrictions on its scope (s 8), the insured's insolvency (ss 10-13) and settlement behind the third party's back (s 14), together with the s 11 information duty, the s 15 surrender duty and the s 16 production duty. NOT ENCODED: s 6's settlement-payment machinery beyond the routing rule, s 17 (deposits), s 18A (solicitation), ss 19-20 (Public Trustee powers), s 21 (power to amend sums), s 22 (securities), s 23 (penalty), s 24 (rules), and the Schedule of territories.
